role: Independent bounded protection review; recommendation to root, not a deployment authorization.
statistical_conclusion: DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY; insufficient for population noninferiority or a general causal regression claim.
frozen_rules: Performance optimization: each protection reviewed separately; credible adverse observations cannot be offset by repeat benefits or target-work reductions.
No frozen requirement that every observed ratio be nonnegative; small observed differences are not automatically confirmed regression.
Two paired startup blocks and three requests per five-tier startup give descriptive evidence; requests within one startup are not independent startup repeats.
No new percentage tolerance, significance threshold, noise-derived acceptance band, parameter scan or automatic extra sampling.

primary_protection_not_cleared.scope: subset head, held-out context-45056 and context-204800, HTTP TTFT
primary_protection_not_cleared.judgement: Both AB/BA blocks have adverse medians, and all three ON observations are slower than all three OFF observations in each block. This repeated ordered separation is a credible bounded adverse signal and is not cleared by these data. It is stronger than a single small median change, without establishing population significance or exact causal attribution.
primary_protection_not_cleared.range_boundary: Observed range separation is a descriptive feature, not a confidence interval, significance test, noise floor or loss tolerance.

new8k_decode.judgement: All four head-by-block medians are adverse. Three paired observed ranges overlap; subset block 2 ranges are strictly separated. Thus the signal is concerning, strongest for subset B2, but does not independently establish a stable population loss. Same target work does not clear the timing protection.

plain_decode.judgement: All five tier medians are adverse; 8K and 200K observed ranges are separated. Only one parent-to-candidate startup pair was measured, with no reverse order. Timing/startup confounding cannot be separated, and three requests are not three independent startup samples. This is auxiliary unresolved protection evidence, not a standalone causal proof.

full_long_ttft.judgement: Full 45K medians are adverse in both blocks but the ranges overlap. Full 200K has one adverse separated block and one near-zero favorable median with a wide ON range. These do not have the same repeatability as the subset long-context TTFT pattern.

supporting_review.other_protections: All head/scenario/metric raw values and ranges are retained below, including favorable and mixed cases. Single-request scenarios have no within-start replication; their point ranges are deliberately not classified as separated evidence.

what_does_not_clear_the_protections: Passing old8K/old45K target-forward and processed-row gates establishes that the diagnosed extra target work was removed; it does not establish unchanged HTTP TTFT/decode.
Passing every new/development repeat gain goal is necessary benefit evidence, not compensation for long-context TTFT protection.
The suffix host counters time only instrumented index operations. Their sub-millisecond scale does not explain the entire observed TTFT difference and cannot subtract it away.
Four separate timing services measure old8K/old45K iterative MTP windows. They do not directly measure new45K/200K prefill/TTFT or the ordinary-decode comparison.
Healthy sampled environment and identical outputs do not exclude timing drift, cache/frequency differences or all sub-sampling interference; no such mechanism was causally identified here.
decision_boundary: Stop this bounded candidate without deployment or additional sampling. Retain f356 and all candidate evidence. This recommendation records protection not cleared, not a theorem of universal slowdown or a statistical noninferiority rejection.
